lead_mention.eventDescription: One person who cleared the noise gate with light topical or low-intent language. Includes the platform, author, intent score, matched phrases, the best post link, and a snippet.

lead_warm.eventDescription: One person showing real intent: a strong intent score (40+) or explicit evaluation language. Includes their best post, all matched intent phrases, topics, post count, recency, and platform engagement.

lead_hot.eventDescription: One person actively evaluating or asking for a recommendation now (intent score 60+ with explicit purchase/switch/recommendation language), ranked by recency and engagement. The most outreach-ready signal. The first hot lead per run is free so you can validate output.
